characters.name: Ada Moss
characters.backstory: Kept the inn open through two floods and knows which tunnels remain passable.
characters.notes: Motivation: Keep refugees safe until they can testify.
characters.summary: The innkeeper shelters witnesses behind a busy common room.
characters.goals: Keep refugees safe until they can testify.

characters.name: Bram Holt
characters.backstory: Lost a crew member to a sealed shipment and no longer trusts official inspections.
characters.notes: Motivation: Win safe working conditions without starving the docks.
characters.summary: A dockworker organizes a strike as the sickness spreads.
characters.goals: Win safe working conditions without starving the docks.

characters.name: Corin Ash
characters.backstory: Borrowed Voss’s money to keep Mercy House supplied without reading its conditions.
characters.notes: Motivation: Protect patients and his sister without covering up the fraud.
characters.summary: Seraphine’s younger brother handles the company’s quiet charity shipments.
characters.goals: Protect patients and his sister without covering up the fraud.

characters.name: Dorian Pike
characters.backstory: Won office on harbor prosperity and fears a scandal will destroy the city’s credit.
characters.notes: Motivation: Save the council’s legitimacy by allowing an honest inquiry.
characters.summary: A cautious speaker controls whether the evidence reaches a public hearing.
characters.goals: Save the council’s legitimacy by allowing an honest inquiry.

characters.name: Elias Reed
characters.backstory: Catalogued the city's records for forty years.
characters.notes: Rescued in event 7; his testimony matters in event 9.
characters.summary: A quiet historian who recognized the seal on a forbidden shipment.
characters.goals: Protect the archives and testify truthfully.

characters.name: Garrick Voss
characters.backstory: Turned emergency harbor powers into a private toll on imported medicine.
characters.notes: Motivation: Destroy the original ledger before the public hearing.
characters.summary: The magistrate protects a smuggling scheme behind legal paperwork.
characters.goals: Destroy the original ledger before the public hearing.

characters.name: Iona Bell
characters.backstory: A retracted story once ruined an innocent sailor; she now demands independent sources.
characters.notes: Motivation: Publish proof rather than another rumor.
characters.summary: An editor risks her press to publish the shipment evidence.
characters.goals: Publish proof rather than another rumor.

characters.name: Liora Fen
characters.backstory: Treated the first cases quietly because officials threatened to close her ward.
characters.notes: Motivation: Obtain clean medicine and protect her patient records.
characters.summary: A physician traces the sickness to diluted antidotes.
characters.goals: Obtain clean medicine and protect her patient records.

characters.name: Mira Vale
characters.backstory: Returned to Greyhaven after training abroad; her missing brother left a ledger of suspicious shipments.
characters.inventory: Healer's kit, brass lantern, brother's ledger
characters.notes: Wants proof before accusing the city council.
characters.summary: A practical healer investigating a sickness spreading through the docks.
characters.goals: Find Rowan and stop the dockside sickness.

characters.name: Nessa Reed
characters.backstory: Inherited a failing ferry and refused to sell its landing to Ash Trading.
characters.inventory: Ferry keys, river charts, signal whistle
characters.notes: Motivation: Find her father without sacrificing her neighbors to the Watch.
characters.summary: Elias’s daughter can cross the river without being seen.
characters.goals: Find her father without sacrificing her neighbors to the Watch.

characters.name: Oren Flint
characters.backstory: His mechanisms were copied to build locks for an illegal quarantine ward.
characters.notes: Motivation: Break those locks and restore the warning bells.
characters.summary: Pip’s former teacher can repair the city’s flood alarm.
characters.goals: Break those locks and restore the warning bells.

characters.name: Pip Copperwhistle
characters.backstory: Grew up repairing dock machinery and carrying messages for sailors.
characters.inventory: Tool roll, grappling hook, clockwork bird
characters.notes: Mira teaches Pip first aid; Pip brings her rumors.
characters.summary: A fast-talking messenger who knows every rooftop route.
characters.goals: Prove useful without putting friends at risk.

characters.name: Rowan Vale
characters.backstory: Signed false manifests to pay family debts, then found poisoned medicine among the cargo.
characters.notes: Motivation: Give Mira the original ledger and admit his own part in the fraud.
characters.summary: Mira’s brother is hiding after copying a dangerous cargo ledger.
characters.goals: Give Mira the original ledger and admit his own part in the fraud.

characters.name: Sable Quinn
characters.backstory: Once carried Ash cargo, then discovered the concealed patients aboard a transport.
characters.notes: Motivation: Keep her crew free and repay the families she unknowingly harmed.
characters.summary: A smuggler offers a route beneath the customs blockade.
characters.goals: Keep her crew free and repay the families she unknowingly harmed.

characters.name: Seraphine Ash
characters.backstory: Built a trade empire after her family's exile.
characters.notes: An alliance becomes a rivalry after the ledger is revealed.
characters.summary: A charming benefactor whose generosity buys silence.
characters.goals: Keep the company solvent while protecting Corin.

characters.name: Tamsin Crow
characters.backstory: Rose through the Watch after exposing payroll theft and believes procedure can still work.
characters.notes: Motivation: Make the arrests stand up in court.
characters.summary: Thorne’s lieutenant must choose between a warrant and her conscience.
characters.goals: Make the arrests stand up in court.

characters.name: Thorne Blackwood
characters.backstory: Mira saved his patrol during a winter siege.
characters.summary: A veteran captain caught between duty and an old debt.
characters.goals: Protect witnesses without destroying the Watch.

characters.name: Wren Sol
characters.backstory: Inherited the post from a parent dismissed for reporting the same signal pattern.
characters.notes: Motivation: Clear the family name and guide rescuers through the storm.
characters.summary: A keeper tracks night signals exchanged with unregistered ships.
characters.goals: Clear the family name and guide rescuers through the storm.

chapters.title: Lanterns in the fog
chapters.summary: The cast follows the first clues through the docks.

chapters.title: The cost of silence
chapters.summary: Secrets split alliances as the city closes in.

chapters.title: A city answers
chapters.summary: A rescue and public reckoning determine Greyhaven’s future.

story_events.title: The dockside fever
story_events.summary: Mira and Liora discover that workers receiving the same imported tonic are becoming ill. Bram demands an inspection; Rowan disappears with a manifest.

story_events.title: A fragile pact
story_events.summary: Seraphine funds Mira’s inquiry to protect her company. Pip carries the agreement while Corin opens the charity shipment records.

story_events.title: The missing archivist
story_events.summary: Elias recognizes a counterfeit customs seal and vanishes. Nessa and Thorne search the river while Iona asks for corroboration.

story_events.title: Lanterns beneath the quay
story_events.summary: Sable and Ada hide Rowan. Wren’s signal log leads Pip and Oren to a locked quarantine ward beneath the warehouse.

story_events.title: The ledger revealed
story_events.summary: Rowan’s original ledger implicates Ash Trading and Voss. Mira breaks with Seraphine; Iona prepares publication and Tamsin secures evidence.

story_events.title: The blockade
story_events.summary: Voss seals the harbor and issues warrants. Bram calls a strike; Thorne temporarily cuts ties with Sable to protect the investigation.

story_events.title: A price for testimony
story_events.summary: Corin admits signing the debt agreement and agrees to testify. Nessa finds Elias alive in the ward; Ada shelters them.

story_events.title: Storm at the floodgates
story_events.summary: The storm threatens the ward. Oren repairs the alarm, Wren signals safe passage, and Thorne renews cooperation with Sable for the rescue.

story_events.title: The public hearing
story_events.summary: Iona publishes the verified documents. Elias and Corin testify; Dorian opens the hearing and Tamsin detains Voss.

story_events.title: A harbor rebuilt
story_events.summary: The council funds clean medicine and worker inspections. Seraphine offers restitution, but Mira’s distrust remains. New partnerships rebuild the docks.
